description: Complete workflow for launching a new product from prototype through production ramp-up and quality certification

tasks.title: Review product specifications and design
tasks.description: Analyze final product design, materials specifications, tolerances, and packaging requirements

tasks.title: Conduct manufacturability assessment
tasks.description: Evaluate design for production feasibility, identify potential issues, suggest optimizations

tasks.title: Source and qualify raw materials
tasks.description: Identify suppliers for required materials, request samples, conduct quality testing

tasks.title: Develop Bill of Materials (BOM)
tasks.description: Create detailed BOM with quantities, specifications, and supplier information in ERPNext

tasks.title: Create production routing and work instructions
tasks.description: Document step-by-step manufacturing process, equipment requirements, and quality checkpoints

tasks.title: Set up tooling and equipment
tasks.description: Configure machinery, create jigs and fixtures, calibrate equipment for new product

tasks.title: Train production staff on new product
tasks.description: Conduct training sessions on assembly procedures, quality standards, and safety requirements

tasks.title: Produce pilot batch (First Article)
tasks.description: Manufacture small pilot run to validate process, identify issues, refine procedures

tasks.title: Conduct First Article Inspection (FAI)
tasks.description: Comprehensive inspection of pilot units against specifications, document all measurements

tasks.title: Address pilot issues and refine process
tasks.description: Implement improvements based on pilot findings, update work instructions and BOM

tasks.title: Produce validation batch
tasks.description: Second production run with refined process to confirm consistency and quality

tasks.title: Conduct final quality certification
tasks.description: Complete quality audit, performance testing, and regulatory compliance verification

tasks.title: Obtain management approval for production
tasks.description: Present validation results and cost analysis to management for production sign-off

tasks.title: Set up inventory and item master in ERPNext
tasks.description: Configure finished goods item, set reorder levels, establish costing methods

tasks.title: Establish safety stock and supplier lead times
tasks.description: Set minimum inventory levels, finalize supplier agreements, schedule regular deliveries

tasks.title: Launch full-scale production
tasks.description: Begin regular production runs, monitor quality metrics, track efficiency and yield

tasks.title: Post-launch review and optimization
tasks.description: Analyze production metrics, identify bottlenecks, implement continuous improvements

description: Comprehensive quality management system audit to ensure compliance with standards and identify improvement opportunities

tasks.title: Define audit scope and objectives
tasks.description: Determine which processes, products, or standards to audit. Set clear audit objectives and success criteria

tasks.title: Assemble audit team and assign roles
tasks.description: Select qualified auditors, assign lead auditor, define responsibilities and areas of focus

tasks.title: Review documentation and previous audits
tasks.description: Study quality manuals, procedures, work instructions, and previous audit findings

tasks.title: Develop audit checklist and schedule
tasks.description: Create detailed checklist based on standards, schedule interviews and observations with production areas

tasks.title: Conduct opening meeting with stakeholders
tasks.description: Brief production team on audit scope, timeline, and expectations. Address questions

tasks.title: Audit production processes and procedures
tasks.description: Observe manufacturing operations, verify adherence to procedures, interview operators

tasks.title: Review quality records and documentation
tasks.description: Examine inspection reports, calibration records, training logs, nonconformance reports

tasks.title: Inspect equipment calibration and maintenance
tasks.description: Verify measurement equipment is calibrated, check preventive maintenance records

tasks.title: Evaluate supplier quality management
tasks.description: Review supplier qualification process, incoming inspection data, supplier performance metrics

tasks.title: Document findings and evidence
tasks.description: Compile all observations, nonconformances, and evidence. Organize by severity and category

tasks.title: Prepare draft audit report
tasks.description: Write comprehensive report detailing findings, nonconformances, and recommendations

tasks.title: Conduct closing meeting
tasks.description: Present findings to management and production team, discuss major issues and timelines

tasks.title: Finalize and distribute audit report
tasks.description: Incorporate feedback, issue final report to stakeholders, track acknowledgment

tasks.title: Develop corrective action plan
tasks.description: Work with production to create action plan addressing each nonconformance with owners and deadlines

tasks.title: Schedule follow-up verification audit
tasks.description: Set date for follow-up to verify corrective actions have been implemented effectively

description: Standard workflow for executing a production run from planning through completion and inventory receipt

tasks.title: Review production order and requirements
tasks.description: Analyze work order quantity, delivery date, special requirements, and customer specifications

tasks.title: Verify material availability
tasks.description: Check inventory levels for all BOM items, identify shortages, expedite procurement if needed

tasks.title: Schedule production slots and resources
tasks.description: Reserve equipment time, assign operators, coordinate with other production runs

tasks.title: Issue raw materials from warehouse
tasks.description: Create material transfer in ERPNext, pull materials from stock, stage at production area

tasks.title: Conduct pre-production quality check
tasks.description: Inspect raw materials for defects, verify specifications, check equipment calibration

tasks.title: Set up production line and tooling
tasks.description: Configure equipment, install fixtures, perform test runs, adjust settings as needed

tasks.title: Begin production - first piece inspection
tasks.description: Produce first units, conduct detailed inspection, verify conformance before full run

tasks.title: Execute full production run
tasks.description: Manufacture complete order quantity following work instructions, record lot numbers

tasks.title: Perform in-process quality inspections
tasks.description: Conduct periodic inspections during production run, document measurements, address issues

tasks.title: Document production metrics and yield
tasks.description: Record actual quantities produced, scrap/rework amounts, cycle times, downtime

tasks.title: Conduct final inspection and testing
tasks.description: Comprehensive inspection of finished goods, functional testing, cosmetic inspection

tasks.title: Package and label finished goods
tasks.description: Package products per specifications, apply labels with lot numbers and dates

tasks.title: Complete work order in ERPNext
tasks.description: Update system with actual quantities, material consumption, labor hours, and completion date

tasks.title: Transfer finished goods to warehouse
tasks.description: Move completed products to finished goods inventory, update stock levels in ERPNext

tasks.title: Notify sales/operations of completion
tasks.description: Inform downstream teams that order is ready for shipment, provide lot numbers and COAs
